name: Blade Ward
desc: Until the spell ends, creatures that attack you subtract 1d4 from each attack roll.

name: Chill Touch
desc: A melee spell attack of necrotic energy. The target also can't regain hit points until the end of your next turn.

name: Eldritch Blast
desc: Hurl a crackling beam as a ranged spell attack. You gain extra beams at character levels 5, 11 and 17, each with its own attack roll.

name: Fire Bolt
desc: Hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object. Unattended flammable objects ignite.

name: Friends
desc: Radiate friendliness at one creature. On a failed Wisdom save it is Charmed. Non-humanoids, foes you are fighting, and recent targets succeed automatically.

name: Guidance
desc: The target adds 1d4 to one ability check of its choice.

name: Light
desc: An object glows with bright light in a 20 ft radius.

name: Mage Hand
desc: A spectral hand appears and can open doors, carry or stow small items, and manipulate objects. It vanishes if it strays over 30 ft from you.

name: Mind Sliver
desc: Splinter a creature's mind. On a failed Intelligence save it takes psychic damage and subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw before the end of your next turn.

name: Minor Illusion
desc: Create a sound or the image of an object. A creature that studies it can see through it with a successful Investigation check.

name: Poison Spray
desc: Spray toxic mist at a creature as a ranged spell attack that deals poison damage.

name: Prestidigitation
desc: Perform minor magical tricks: harmless sensory effects, lighting or snuffing small flames, cleaning, soiling, chilling, warming, flavoring, a small mark, or a trinket.

name: Ray of Frost
desc: A frigid beam hits the target and cuts its speed by 10 ft until the start of your next turn.

name: Sacred Flame
desc: Radiance descends on a creature you can see. Cover gives it no bonus to the save.

name: Shocking Grasp
desc: Lightning leaps from your hand. The target can't take reactions until its next turn.

name: Thunderclap
desc: A burst of thunder, audible up to 100 ft away, damages creatures within 5 ft of you that fail a Constitution save.

name: Toll the Dead
desc: A dolorous bell tolls for one creature. On a failed Wisdom save it takes necrotic damage, using the larger die if it is already missing hit points.

name: True Strike
components: S, M (a weapon you are proficient with, worth 1+ CP)
desc: Make one attack with the weapon, using your spellcasting ability for attack and damage rolls. It may deal radiant damage, plus extra radiant damage at levels 5, 11 and 17.

name: Vicious Mockery
desc: A cutting insult. On a failed save the target has disadvantage on its next attack roll.

name: Armor of Agathys
components: V, S, M (a shard of blue glass)
desc: Frost grants you 5 temporary hit points. Creatures that hit you with a melee attack take cold damage until those temporary hit points are gone.
higher: Temporary hit points and cold damage each increase by 5 per slot level above 1st.

name: Arms of Hadar
desc: Tendrils erupt around you. Creatures in the area take necrotic damage on a failed Strength save (half on success) and can't take reactions until their next turn.
higher: +1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Bane
components: V, S, M (a drop of blood)
desc: Up to three creatures that fail a Charisma save must subtract 1d4 from their attack rolls and saving throws.
higher: One extra creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Bless
desc: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.
higher: One extra creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Burning Hands
desc: Flames fan out from your fingers. Half damage on a successful save.
higher: +1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Charm Person
desc: A humanoid that fails a Wisdom save is Charmed and Friendly to you until the spell ends or you or your allies damage it.
higher: One extra creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Comprehend Languages
components: V, S, M (a pinch of soot and salt)
desc: You understand any language you hear or see signed, and written text you touch. It doesn't reveal codes or secret symbols.

name: Cure Wounds
desc: A creature you touch regains hit points equal to the dice plus your spellcasting modifier.
higher: +1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Detect Magic
desc: Sense magic within 30 ft. Use your action to see auras around magical creatures and objects and learn the school of any spell responsible.

name: Expeditious Retreat
desc: You take the Dash action when you cast this, and can take it again as a bonus action on each of your turns until the spell ends.

name: Guiding Bolt
desc: A flash of light. The next attack roll against the target before your next turn has advantage.
higher: +1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Healing Word
desc: A creature you can see regains hit points equal to the dice plus your spellcasting modifier.
higher: +1d4 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Hellish Rebuke
time: Reaction (when a creature within 60 ft damages you)
desc: The creature that hurt you is wreathed in green flames. It takes fire damage on a failed Dexterity save, or half on a success.
higher: +1d10 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Hex
components: V, S, M (the petrified eye of a newt)
desc: Curse a creature. Your hits deal extra necrotic damage to it, and it has disadvantage on checks with one ability you choose. If it drops to 0 HP you can move the curse as a bonus action.
higher: Duration grows with slot level: 2nd up to 4 hours, 3rd-4th up to 8 hours, 5th+ up to 24 hours.

name: Illusory Script
components: S, M (ink worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes)
desc: Write a message that only you and creatures you choose can read normally. To everyone else it looks like an unknown or different script.

name: Mage Armor
desc: A willing creature wearing no armor has base AC 13 + Dex modifier.

name: Magic Missile
desc: Three glowing darts strike creatures you choose and never miss.
higher: One extra dart for each slot level above 1st.

name: Shield
desc: +5 AC until your next turn, including against the triggering attack. Negates Magic Missile.

name: Sleep
desc: Roll 5d8: creatures in a 20 ft radius with that many total hit points or fewer fall unconscious, lowest first.
higher: +2d8 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Speak with Animals
desc: You can understand and talk with beasts, and use Influence action options on them.

name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
components: V, S, M (a tart and a feather)
desc: A creature that fails a Wisdom save falls Prone and Incapacitated, laughing helplessly. It repeats the save each turn and when it takes damage.
higher: One extra creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Thunderwave
desc: A booming wave. Failed save: damage and pushed 10 ft. Success: half damage.
higher: +1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Unseen Servant
components: V, S, M (a bit of string and of wood)
desc: An invisible, mindless force performs simple tasks such as fetching, cleaning and opening doors. It can't attack and has 1 hit point.

name: Witch Bolt
components: V, S, M (a twig struck by lightning)
desc: A ranged spell attack forms an arc of lightning to the target. On later turns you can use a bonus action to deal lightning damage to it again.
higher: The initial damage rises by 1d12 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Cloud of Daggers
components: V, S, M (a sliver of glass)
desc: Spinning daggers fill a 5 ft cube, damaging creatures that enter or end their turn there (once per turn). A Magic action later lets you teleport the cube.
higher: +2d4 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Crown of Madness
desc: A creature that fails a Wisdom save is Charmed, and a spectral crown compels it to attack creatures you choose. It repeats the save each turn.

name: Darkness
components: V, M (bat fur and a piece of coal)
desc: A 15 ft sphere of magical Darkness spreads from a point or object. Darkvision can't see through it and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

name: Enthrall
desc: Your words captivate creatures of your choice that fail a Wisdom save, giving them a -10 penalty to Perception. Creatures you are fighting succeed automatically.

name: Hold Person
components: V, S, M (a straight piece of iron)
desc: A humanoid that fails a Wisdom save is Paralyzed, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.
higher: One extra humanoid for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Invisibility
components: V, S, M (an eyelash in gum arabic)
desc: A creature you touch is Invisible until the spell ends or until it attacks, deals damage or casts a spell.
higher: One extra creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Mind Spike
desc: Psionic energy deals psychic damage on a failed Wisdom save (half on success). On a failure you also know the target's location while on the same plane.
higher: +1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Mirror Image
desc: Three illusory duplicates of you appear and move with you, making it hard to tell which one is real.

name: Misty Step
desc: Surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
desc: A sapping beam. On a failed Constitution save the target has disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and its damage rolls are reduced; on a success it has disadvantage on its next attack.

name: Scorching Ray
desc: Three rays of fire, each needing its own attack roll.
higher: One extra ray for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Shatter
desc: A painfully loud ring in a 10 ft radius. Half damage on a success.
higher: +1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Spider Climb
components: V, S, M (a drop of bitumen and a spider)
desc: A willing creature can climb walls and ceilings with its hands free and gains a Climb Speed equal to its Speed.
higher: One extra creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Spiritual Weapon
desc: A floating weapon strikes on the turn you cast it and as a bonus action on later turns.
higher: +1d8 for every two slot levels above 2nd.

name: Suggestion
desc: Suggest a reasonable course of action in 25 words or fewer. A creature that fails a Wisdom save is Charmed and pursues it.

name: Counterspell
time: Reaction (when a creature within 60 ft casts a spell)
desc: Interrupt a spell being cast. The caster must succeed on a Constitution save or the spell fails, and a spent spell slot is not expended.

name: Dispel Magic
desc: End a spell on a target. Spells of level 3 or lower end automatically; for higher-level spells you make a spellcasting ability check (DC 10 + spell level).
higher: Automatically ends any spell whose level is no higher than the slot you use.

name: Fear
desc: Creatures in the cone that fail a Wisdom save drop what they hold and become Frightened, fleeing from you.

name: Fireball
desc: A bright streak blossoms into a 20 ft radius explosion. Half damage on a success.
higher: +1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Fly
desc: A willing creature you touch gains a Fly Speed of 60 ft and can hover. It falls when the spell ends if still aloft.
higher: One extra creature for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Gaseous Form
components: V, S, M (a bit of gauze)
desc: A willing creature becomes a misty cloud with a slow Fly Speed, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, and the ability to slip through narrow gaps.
higher: One extra creature for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Hunger of Hadar
desc: A 20 ft sphere of void and darkness blinds creatures within and is difficult terrain. Starting a turn there deals cold damage; ending a turn there deals acid damage on a failed Dexterity save.
higher: Cold or acid damage (your choice) +1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Hypnotic Pattern
desc: A swirling pattern Charms creatures that fail a Wisdom save, leaving them Incapacitated with Speed 0 until harmed or shaken free.

name: Lightning Bolt
desc: A 5 ft wide bolt of lightning. Half damage on a success.
higher: +1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Magic Circle
components: V, S, M (salt and powdered silver worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes)
desc: A 10 ft radius cylinder bars chosen creature types (Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, Undead) from entering, or traps them inside, depending on how you set it.
higher: Duration increases by 1 hour for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Major Image
components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece)
desc: Create an image of an object, creature or phenomenon up to a 20 ft cube with matching sound, smell and temperature. It can't deal damage or cause conditions.
higher: Lasts until dispelled, with no Concentration, when cast with a level 4+ slot.

name: Remove Curse
desc: All curses on a creature or object you touch end. A cursed item stays cursed, but its owner's attunement to it is broken.

name: Revivify
desc: Return a creature that died within the last minute to life with 1 hit point.

name: Spirit Guardians
desc: Spirits surround you and hamper hostile creatures. Half damage on a success.
higher: +1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Summon Fey
components: V, S, M (a gilded flower worth 300+ GP)
desc: Call a Fey spirit in a chosen mood (Fuming, Mirthful or Tricksy) that fights for you. Its stat block uses the slot's level.
higher: Use the slot's level as the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Summon Undead
components: V, S, M (a gilded skull worth 300+ GP)
desc: Call an Undead spirit in a chosen form (Ghostly, Putrid or Skeletal) that fights for you. Its stat block uses the slot's level.
higher: Use the slot's level as the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Tongues
desc: A creature you touch understands any language it hears or sees, and others who know a language can understand it when it speaks.

name: Vampiric Touch
desc: A melee spell attack siphons life: it deals necrotic damage and you regain half that amount. You can attack again each turn.
higher: +1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Banishment
desc: A creature that fails a Charisma save is sent to a harmless demiplane, Incapacitated. Extraplanar creatures may not return if the spell lasts a full minute.
higher: One extra creature for each slot level above 4th.

name: Blight
desc: Withering energy deals necrotic damage on a failed Constitution save (half on success). Plant creatures automatically fail; nonmagical plants simply die.
higher: +1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Charm Monster
desc: A creature that fails a Wisdom save is Charmed and Friendly to you until you or your allies damage it.
higher: One extra creature for each slot level above 4th.

name: Dimension Door
desc: Teleport to a location you can see, picture or describe, optionally taking one willing creature. If the arrival space is blocked you take force damage and the teleport fails.

name: Hallucinatory Terrain
desc: Make natural terrain in a 150 ft cube look, sound and smell like a different kind of natural terrain.

name: Ice Storm
desc: Hail pounds a 20 ft radius and makes the ground difficult terrain. Half damage on a success.
higher: +1d8 bludgeoning for each slot level above 4th.

name: Polymorph
desc: Turn a creature into a beast of challenge rating equal to or lower than its level.

name: Summon Aberration
components: V, S, M (a pickled tentacle and an eyeball in a platinum-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP)
desc: Call an aberrant spirit (Beholderkin, Mind Flayer or Slaad) that fights for you. Its stat block uses the slot's level.
higher: Use the slot's level as the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Cone of Cold
desc: A blast of cold air. Creatures killed by it become frozen statues. Half damage on a success.
higher: +1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Contact Other Plane
desc: Contact an otherworldly entity and ask up to five questions. A failed DC 15 Intelligence save costs you psychic damage and leaves you Incapacitated until a Long Rest.

name: Dream
components: V, S, M (a handful of sand)
desc: Send a dream messenger to a creature you know. Alternatively inflict a nightmare: on a failed Wisdom save the target gains no benefit from its rest and takes psychic damage on waking.

name: Flame Strike
desc: A column of divine fire in a 10 ft radius. Half damage on a success.
higher: +1d6 fire or radiant for each slot level above 5th.

name: Hold Monster
components: V, S, M (a straight piece of iron)
desc: A creature that fails a Wisdom save is Paralyzed, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.
higher: One extra creature for each slot level above 5th.

name: Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance
components: V, S, M (a pinch of phosphorus)
desc: A 10 ft radius, 40 ft tall storm of light and thunder Blinds and Deafens creatures inside, stops verbal spellcasting, and deals radiant and thunder damage on a failed Constitution save.
higher: Radiant and thunder damage each rise by 1d10 per slot level above 5th.

name: Mislead
desc: You turn Invisible while an illusory double of you appears. You can move the double and perceive through it with a Magic action.

name: Planar Binding
components: V, S, M (a jewel worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
desc: Attempt to bind a captive Celestial, Elemental, Fey or Fiend to your service for the duration.

name: Scrying
components: V, S, M (a focus worth 1,000+ GP, such as a crystal ball, mirror or water-filled font)
desc: See and hear a chosen creature on your plane. Its Wisdom save is modified by how well you know it and what link you hold.

name: Synaptic Static
desc: A psychic burst in a 20 ft sphere deals damage (Intelligence save for half). On a failure, creatures also have muddled thoughts that hinder attacks, checks and concentration for a minute.

name: Teleportation Circle
components: V, M (rare inks worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes)
desc: Draw a circle that opens a portal to a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know.

name: Wall of Force
desc: An invisible, indestructible wall of force that nothing can physically pass through.

name: Arcane Gate
desc: Create two linked portals on the ground, one within range and one within 10 ft of you. Anything entering one exits the other.

name: Chain Lightning
desc: A bolt strikes one target, then arcs to up to three others within 30 ft. Half damage on a success.
higher: One extra target for each slot level above 6th.

name: Circle of Death
components: V, S, M (the powder of a crushed black pearl worth 500+ GP)
desc: A 60 ft radius sphere of negative energy deals necrotic damage to creatures in it (Constitution save for half).
higher: +2d8 for each slot level above 6th.

name: Create Undead
components: V, S, M (one 150+ GP black onyx stone for each corpse)
desc: Cast only at night. Raise up to three Medium or Small humanoid corpses as Ghouls under your control, commanded with a bonus action.

name: Disintegrate
desc: A thin green ray. A target reduced to 0 hit points turns to fine dust.

name: Eyebite
desc: Your eyes become an inky void. Each turn target a creature that fails a Wisdom save with an effect of your choice: put it to sleep, terrify it, or sicken it.

name: Summon Fiend
components: V, S, M (a bloody vial worth 600+ GP)
desc: Call a fiendish spirit (Demon, Devil or Yugoloth) that fights for you. Its stat block uses the slot's level.
higher: Use the slot's level as the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron
components: V, S, M (a gilded ladle worth 500+ GP)
desc: Conjure a cauldron of bubbling liquid that duplicates the properties of a Common or Uncommon potion, which you or others can ladle out.

name: True Seeing
components: V, S, M (mushroom powder worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)
desc: A willing creature you touch gains Truesight with a range of 120 ft.

name: Etherealness
desc: Step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane where it overlaps your current plane.

name: Finger of Death
desc: Negative energy deals massive necrotic damage on a failed Constitution save (half on success). A humanoid it kills rises as your Zombie.

name: Forcecage
components: V, S, M (ruby dust worth 1,500+ GP, which the spell consumes)
desc: An immobile, invisible cube-shaped prison of force, either a barred cage or a solid box, springs up around an area you choose.

name: Plane Shift
components: V, S, M (a forked metal rod worth 250+ GP and attuned to a plane of existence)
desc: You and up to eight willing creatures linking hands travel to another plane of existence.

name: Befuddlement
components: V, S, M (a key ring with no keys)
desc: Blast a creature's mind. On a failed Intelligence save it takes heavy psychic damage and can't cast spells or take the Magic action until the effect ends; half damage on a success.

name: Demiplane
desc: Create a shadowy door on a flat surface that leads to an empty 30 ft room in a demiplane.

name: Dominate Monster
desc: A creature that fails a Wisdom save is Charmed and telepathically linked to you, obeying your commands. It repeats the save whenever it takes damage.
higher: Concentration can last up to 8 hours with a level 9 slot.

name: Glibness
desc: Your Charisma check rolls can be replaced with a 15, and magic can't detect that you are lying.

name: Power Word Stun
desc: A creature with 150 HP or fewer is Stunned (Constitution save each turn to end it). A stronger creature just has its Speed reduced to 0 until your next turn.

name: Astral Projection
components: V, S, M (for each target, a jacinth and a silver bar, which the spell consumes)
desc: You and up to eight willing creatures project astral bodies into the Astral Plane, leaving your bodies behind in suspended animation.

name: Foresight
desc: A willing creature you touch glimpses the near future, gaining advantage on D20 Tests while attacks against it have disadvantage.

name: Gate
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 5,000+ GP)
desc: Conjure a portal linking a space you can see to a precise location on a different plane of existence.

name: Imprisonment
components: V, S, M (a statuette of the target worth 5,000+ GP)
desc: A creature that fails a Wisdom save is magically imprisoned in a form of confinement you choose, needing no food, air or sleep.

name: Meteor Swarm
desc: Four blazing orbs strike different points and explode in 40 ft radius spheres. Half damage on a success.

name: Power Word Kill
desc: A creature with 100 HP or fewer dies. A stronger creature takes psychic damage instead.

name: True Polymorph
components: V, S, M (a drop of mercury, a dollop of gum arabic and a wisp of smoke)
desc: Transform a creature or nonmagical object into a different creature or object.

name: Weird
desc: Phantasmal terrors fill a 30 ft radius sphere. Creatures that fail a Wisdom save take psychic damage and are Frightened (half damage on a success).
